pr_title: Solve IMO 2026 Problem 1 (Confucius gcd/lcm blackboard): prove termination with one survivor M and M independent of choices. Three independent rigorous proofs APPROVED — per-prime Euclidean invariant (canonical), integer product monovariant, and multiset-confluence via Newman's lemma. M = ∏_p p^{D_p} where D_p = gcd of p-valuations of the initial board.

rounds.summary: Solved IMO 2026 P1 (imo-2026-01) both parts: 3 APPROVED approaches
